newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Templeton launches Global Growth Fund in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Templeton launches Global Growth Fund in Singapore.

text.p: Templeton Asset Management Ltd launched on Monday the Singapore version of its flagship Global Growth Fund, Templeton officials said.
The new fund is the sixth sub-fund of their Singapore umbrella fund, Templeton Investment Funds.
The Global Growth Fund is a globally invested equity fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing primarily into securities of major corporations listed on stock exchanges around the world.
Thomas Graeff, General Manager for Templeton's Sales and Marketing Division, told a news conference that the Global Fund presently invests in 129 stocks from 33 countries.
Graeff said some 25 percent of the fund was in cash. "If there's a correction in some of the markets, we're very well positioned," he said.
Of the 75 percent in the fund actually invested in stocks, he said some 15 percent was placed in the emerging markets.
